about: Components that tools/unreal-engine/python/build_player.py adds to the production player (/Game/Lunden/Player/). Other issues add their own rows here instead of opening the player Blueprints. target: character (BP_LundenPlayer) or controller (BP_LundenPlayerController); name: the component variable name, unique per target; class: a component class path (a Blueprint component ends in _C); owner: the issue that owns the row and the class; what: one line. The builder adds missing rows, removes components it added earlier whose row is gone, and leaves every other component alone. docs/development/unreal.md#player-2284

components.name: Seasons
components.what: shows seasonal pieces (actor tag seasonal: the Christmas tree) only inside their season window, from the PC's local date at game start (build_seasons.py)

components.name: Save
components.what: puts the player back at the saved place and facing at game start and saves the place every 2 s and at the end, in the user's save folder (build_save.py)

components.name: UI
components.what: the compass, the frame rate, the start and pause menu (Esc) and the saved graphics, mouse and volume settings (build_ui.py)

components.name: StepSurface
components.what: what is under the feet (surface grass/hard/gravel/wood, where ground/exposed/core/indoor, road, stairs, outdoor) from the web's src/stepsurface.js, sampled by export-player.js; FeetInfo() for #2287's footsteps and the outdoor sprint (player_parts.py)

components.name: Rest
components.what: sit and lie down on furniture with E (src/rest.js): the eye glides to the web's rest spot, the view is clamped, E, Space or Ctrl stands up (player_parts.py)

components.name: Audio
components.what: footsteps per surface (src/footsteps.js pickStep, one MetaSound per profile), the wind and the outdoor bed (src/windsound.js, src/ambientbed.js) and the room's reverb zone (src/roomreverb.js) (build_audio.py)

components.name: NetworkPeers
components.what: displays and interpolates the other players from the local launcher snapshot

components.name: Network
components.what: exchanges only public presence, appearance and movement with the launcher through private session files

components.name: SharedRoom
components.what: chat, shared registered doors and room life on the player's existing presence connection
